title: Debug: The Audit Log Is Missing An Entry
description:
This is meant to be a complete audit trail of every order line from both `source_orders` and `warehouse_orders` — every real row should show up, even if two rows happen to look identical. But a known duplicate entry in the source system isn't showing up twice in the output like it should. Find the bug and fix it.

Name the columns `order_id`, `customer_name` and `amount`. Return the result in any order.
hint: UNION always removes duplicate rows across both sides — exactly the wrong behavior for an audit log, where two identical-looking rows might be two genuinely separate events. UNION ALL keeps everything.

tests.name: Example
All three systems fully agree
Completely disjoint across all three
Source has an accidental duplicate row
Only source has any data
tests.seedSql: INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'Ann Lee',120.0),(2,'Ben Kim',80.0),(3,'Cy Ortiz',45.5);

tests.name: Same order, inconsistent name formatting
Matching ids, mismatched amounts
Single matching order everywhere
Larger mixed set: some in all three, some in two, some in one, duplicates and a mismatch
Identical rows exist in both tables
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0);

tests.name: No duplicate rows — UNION and UNION ALL agree
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (3,'C',300.0);

tests.name: Only source has data — all rows kept
